title: Live-Aktualisierung des Prüfstatus in der Oberfläche
description: As a developer, I want the interface to show the status change without a reload, so that I know immediately whether my prompt is approved.

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt version is in status SCANNING and the user has the list open
acceptance_criteria.when: the scan finishes and the status changes to APPROVED
acceptance_criteria.then: the interface shows APPROVED within two seconds without a manual reload
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-024-live-status.feature: The status change appears without reloading

acceptance_criteria.when: a client opens the live status channel
acceptance_criteria.then: the server refuses the connection and no status data is streamed
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-024-live-status.feature: The live channel rejects unauthenticated clients

acceptance_criteria.given: the live channel drops while a scan is running
acceptance_criteria.then: the client receives the current status of the prompt and continues to receive updates
and: no intermediate update is delivered twice with a different state
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-024-live-status.feature: After a lost connection the current state is restored
